raw_response:
This rented beans plot is small, and here in Tabora I usually manage with what my household can afford and do by hand. For beans mixed with other crops, I will not buy chemical fertilizer, and I will use my own local seed. If I can get some manure, I will put a little on the plot, but I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide or herbicide.
